nodes.label: Dashboard & Reports Options Brainstorm
nodes.rationale: Interactive brainstorm with phone mockups comparing dashboard and reports options for combined Assessor+Mentor roles.

nodes.label: Decision: Unified Scrollable Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Recommended for combined Assessor+Mentor roles because both roles are visible at once, no extra taps, and sections deep-link to tabs.

nodes.label: Decision: Inner Tabs for Reports
nodes.rationale: Recommended because assessment and mentorship reports are structurally very different; tabs give each domain full-screen space while keeping a single Reports nav item.
